Bengal Multiplex Serves Only Vegetarian Food During 'Ramayana: Part 1'

A multiplex cinema chain in West Bengal, identified as SVF cinemas, has decided to serve only vegetarian food and beverages inside its theatres during screenings of the film 'Ramayana: Part 1'. The decision was reportedly made in response to the film's theme, which is based on the Hindu epic.
